say:2:1211133001:0.text: We finally did it! We made it back to Rustport in one piece!
say:2:1211133001:0.source_cn: 成功了，成功了！我们平安返回锈锚港了！

say:3:1211133002:0.text: Cheers to Captain Sinbad! Thanks to you, we set sail just in time!
say:3:1211133002:0.source_cn: 辛巴达船长万岁！多亏你及时开船！

say:4:1211133003:0.text: It's all thanks to this compass...
say:4:1211133003:0.male: It's all thanks to this compass...
say:4:1211133003:0.female: It's all thanks to this compass...

choice_prompt:5:1211133003.text: It's all thanks to this compass...
choice_prompt:5:1211133003.male: It's all thanks to this compass...
choice_prompt:5:1211133003.female: It's all thanks to this compass...

say:6:1211133005:0.text: Really? Just for a moment there, I felt like I heard my old man's voice.
say:6:1211133005:0.source_cn: 我也不知道，就刚才那一瞬间，我好像听见了老爹的叮嘱。
say:6:1211133005:0.male: Really? Just for a moment there, I felt like I heard my old man's voice.
say:6:1211133005:0.female: Really? Just for a moment there, I felt like I heard my old man's voice.

say:7:1211133007:0.text: You're already a real captain! From now on, the compass will guide you wherever you want to go!
say:7:1211133007:0.source_cn: 你已经是个真正的船长了！今后，无论你要去哪，都有罗盘为...

say:8:1211133008:0.text: *Nervous laughter* We've only got one problem now—Hodgkin took Nara.
say:8:1211133008:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈……唯一可惜的是，奈拉被霍德希金带走了。

say:11:1211133009:0.text: I have to bring her back!
say:11:1211133009:0.source_cn: 我一定要把奈拉带回来！

say:12:1211133010:0.text: Calm down, Sonja. I understand how you feel, but you saw what Hodgkin's little trinket did to Nara. We need to come up with a plan.
say:12:1211133010:0.source_cn: 你冷静点，我理解你的心情。但是霍德希金的那个宝贝你们也...

say:13:1211133011:0.text: What's the deal with that thing anyway?

say:14:1211133012:0.text: Water Wights, here's your chance to get back at Hodgkin! You've been wronged, and now is the perfect time for revenge!
say:14:1211133012:0.source_cn: 水鬼帮的兄弟，是你们戴罪立功的时候了，霍德希金都这么对...

say:18:1211133014:0.text: That thing of Hodgkin's can turn the living into Graveborns! The Dead Tide Fleet calls it the "Void Relic."
say:18:1211133014:0.source_cn: 死潮舰队把那东西称作<style=highlight>...

say:19:1211133015:0.text: Where did he get it from?
say:19:1211133015:0.source_cn: 这么厉害？他从哪弄来的？

say:20:1211133016:0.text: I have no idea. Nara's been trying to get her hands on it for ages, but even she doesn't know much about it. It seems like only Hodgkin's most trusted advisors, like Viperian, get to see it up close.
say:20:1211133016:0.source_cn: 不知道，奈拉大姐头一直想搞来玩玩，但就连她也不知道。好...

say:23:1211133017:0.text: Well, if that's the case, attacking them head-on isn't the smartest option. We need to come up with a clever plan.
say:23:1211133017:0.source_cn: 既然如此，从正面进攻对我们来说不明智，还是要智取。

say:24:1211133018:0.text: Don't get any ideas about stealing it! That thing can recognize its owner! Those who tried to steal it before didn't end well.
say:24:1211133018:0.source_cn: 你们也别想着偷它！那东西认主，曾经有人去偷，下场很惨。

say:25:1211133019:0.text: Alright, thanks for letting us know. Consider this your chance to make up for your past mistakes.
say:25:1211133019:0.source_cn: 行，知道了，算你戴罪立功。

say:28:1211133020:0.text: Sonja, what should we do next?

say:29:1211133021:0.text: The Dead Tide Fleet could strike at any time. We need to find Hugin and get the Chainkeeper ready with some cannons.
say:29:1211133021:0.source_cn: 死潮舰队随时可能攻过来，先去找呼金，把枷锁号也装上大炮。

choice:5:0:1.text: You were the one using the compass.
choice:5:0:1.male: You were the one using the compass.
choice:5:0:1.female: You were the one using the compass.

say:31:1211133004:0.text: I don't really know what happened, but for a moment, I felt like a real captain...
say:31:1211133004:0.source_cn: 是吗？我也不知道怎么回事，那一瞬间，感觉自己好像一个真...
say:31:1211133004:0.male: I don't really know what happened, but for a moment, I felt like a real captain...
say:31:1211133004:0.female: I don't really know what happened, but for a moment, I felt like a real captain...

say:32:1211133006:0.text: And when I do become one, I'll navigate my own course...
say:32:1211133006:0.source_cn: 当我成为一个真正的船长，我就可以驶出自己的航路……

choice:5:1:2.text: You've figured out how to use the compass?
choice:5:1:2.male: You've figured out how to use the compass?
choice:5:1:2.female: You've figured out how to use the compass?

say:0:1211134001:0.text: Wow! You guys are finally back!
say:0:1211134001:0.source_cn: 哇嚯嚯嚯！你们可算回来了！
say:0:1211134001:0.male: Wow! You guys are finally back!
say:0:1211134001:0.female: Wow! You guys are finally back!

say:1:1211135001:1.text: What happened? Lucca went to the Wights' base and found it completely destroyed, but you guys were nowhere to be seen.
say:1:1211135001:1.source_cn: 到底咋回事？卢卡带人去了水鬼大本营，发现他们都被灭了，...
say:1:1211135001:1.male: What happened? Lucca went to the Wights' base and found it completely destroyed, but you guys were nowhere to be seen.
say:1:1211135001:1.female: What happened? Lucca went to the Wights' base and found it completely destroyed, but you guys were nowhere to be seen.

say:2:1211135002:1.text: If you had taken any longer to come back, me and Lucca would've taken our men to go bombard the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:2:1211135002:1.source_cn: 要是你们再不回来，我就要和卢卡带人去炮轰死潮舰队了！
say:2:1211135002:1.male: If you had taken any longer to come back, me and Lucca would've taken our men to go bombard the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:2:1211135002:1.female: If you had taken any longer to come back, me and Lucca would've taken our men to go bombard the Dead Tide Fleet.

say:4:1211135003:1.text: We got delayed on the way back because we ran into Hodgkin.
say:4:1211135003:1.source_cn: 我们回程碰上了霍德希金，所以耽误了。

narration:5:1211135004:1.text: You share with Hugin all that has happened on this journey, from your experiences on the Dream Isle to the encounters with Hodgkin and the Dead Tide Fleet.
narration:5:1211135004:1.male: You share with Hugin all that has happened on this journey, from your experiences on the Dream Isle to the encounters with Hodgkin and the Dead Tide Fleet.
narration:5:1211135004:1.female: You share with Hugin all that has happened on this journey, from your experiences on the Dream Isle to the encounters with Hodgkin and the Dead Tide Fleet.

say:6:1211135005:1.text: That old seal rat stole my baby and used it against you? I'll load our ship with Flintbombers right now! Next time, we see him, I'll blow his head off!
say:6:1211135005:1.source_cn: 霍德希金那个老不死的，偷了我的宝贝炮轰你们？我这就把咱...
say:6:1211135005:1.male: That old seal rat stole my baby and used it against you? I'll load our ship with Flintbombers right now! Next time, we see him, I'll blow his head off!
say:6:1211135005:1.female: That old seal rat stole my baby and used it against you? I'll load our ship with Flintbombers right now! Next time, we see him, I'll blow his head off!

say:7:1211135006:1.text: Well, it seems like you came out ahead after all. You survived the Dead Tide Fleet and struck gold at the Dream Isle!
say:7:1211135006:1.source_cn: 不过你们也算因祸得福，碰上死潮舰队不仅平安返回，还去了...
say:7:1211135006:1.male: Well, it seems like you came out ahead after all. You survived the Dead Tide Fleet and struck gold at the Dream Isle!
say:7:1211135006:1.female: Well, it seems like you came out ahead after all. You survived the Dead Tide Fleet and struck gold at the Dream Isle!

say:9:1211135007:1.text: Not really. I just picked up a compass.
say:9:1211135007:1.source_cn: 也没有，我也就捡了个罗盘。

say:11:1211135008:1.text: Wow, is that really you, Sinbad? I almost didn't recognize you! You look like a real captain in that getup. If you didn't talk, I'd swear you were the real deal!
say:11:1211135008:1.source_cn: 哇！你是……？辛巴达！我还以为我眼花了，瞧你这身……只...

say:12:1211135009:1.text: I guess I'll take that as a compliment. Y'know, I've learned a lot from this trip... Hey! Don't get so close!
say:12:1211135009:1.source_cn: 谢谢夸奖，这一趟，我已经明白——喂喂！别凑那么近！

say:13:1211135010:1.text: Show me that treasure of yours! Woah, look at the craftsmanship and the details... It's simply extraordinary!
say:13:1211135010:1.source_cn: 让我看看你手上的好宝贝……这制造工艺，这种刻度……一个...

say:14:1211135011:1.text: Fine, you can look at it, but you better not try to take it!
say:14:1211135011:1.source_cn: ……这明明是两个字。行了，想看就给你看，但不许拿走！

say:15:1211135012:0.text: So this treasure helped you escape from the Dead Tide Fleet? I definitely need to look into it...
say:15:1211135012:0.source_cn: 就是这宝贝帮你们摆脱了死潮舰队？我可要好好研究研究……

say:17:1211135013:1.text: Hugin, did you get the communicators set up yet?
say:17:1211135013:1.source_cn: 呼金，之前让你准备的通讯器呢？怎么样了？

say:18:1211135014:1.text: Of course! One for Sinbad, one for Magister Merlin, one for Sonja, and one for me!
say:18:1211135014:1.source_cn: 早准备好了！来来来，辛巴达一个，梅林一个，索尼娅一个，...
say:18:1211135014:1.male: Of course! One for Sinbad, one for Magister Merlin, one for Sonja, and one for me!
say:18:1211135014:1.female: Of course! One for Sinbad, one for Magister Merlin, one for Sonja, and one for me!

choice_prompt:19:1211135014.text: Of course! One for Sinbad, one for Magister Merlin, one for Sonja, and one for me!
choice_prompt:19:1211135014.source_cn: 早准备好了！来来来，辛巴达一个，梅林一个，索尼娅一个，我一个。
choice_prompt:19:1211135014.male: Of course! One for Sinbad, one for Magister Merlin, one for Sonja, and one for me!
choice_prompt:19:1211135014.female: Of course! One for Sinbad, one for Magister Merlin, one for Sonja, and one for me!

say:20:1211135015:1.text: Well, this is a communication device that lets us talk from afar. I named it Merlindabest!
say:20:1211135015:1.source_cn: 可以远程通话的通讯器，我叫它梅赛达斯！
say:20:1211135015:1.male: Well, this is a communication device that lets us talk from afar. I named it Merlindabest!
say:20:1211135015:1.female: Well, this is a communication device that lets us talk from afar. I named it Merlindabest!

say:21:1211135016:1.text: Here, let me show you how to use it!
say:21:1211135016:1.male: Here, let me show you how to use it!
say:21:1211135016:1.female: Here, let me show you how to use it!

say:27:1211135018:0.text: H-hello? Hello? Hey... Hey, friends! Can anyone hear me?
say:27:1211135018:0.male: H-hello? Hello? Hey... Hey, friends! Can anyone hear me?
say:27:1211135018:0.female: H-hello? Hello? Hey... Hey, friends! Can anyone hear me?

say:32:1211135019:0.text: Wow, this is amazing! Hugin is so far off, yet it feels like he's talking right in front of us!
say:32:1211135019:0.source_cn: 哇！好神奇！呼金明明离我们这么远了，但是看起来就像在我...
say:32:1211135019:0.male: Wow, this is amazing! Hugin is so far off, yet it feels like he's talking right in front of us!
say:32:1211135019:0.female: Wow, this is amazing! Hugin is so far off, yet it feels like he's talking right in front of us!

say:37:1211135020:0.text: Alright, Merlindabest will help you stay connected if you end up splitting up again!
say:37:1211135020:0.source_cn: 有了小梅，你们要是再分头行动，就可以靠它来保持联络了！
say:37:1211135020:0.male: Alright, Merlindabest will help you stay connected if you end up splitting up again!
say:37:1211135020:0.female: Alright, Merlindabest will help you stay connected if you end up splitting up again!

say:42:1211135021:0.text: Merlindabest...? Is it named after Magister Merlin since he helped you out?
say:42:1211135021:0.source_cn: 小梅？呃，是因为梅林帮你附魔，所以……？
say:42:1211135021:0.male: Merlindabest...? Is it named after Magister Merlin since he helped you out?
say:42:1211135021:0.female: Merlindabest...? Is it named after Magister Merlin since she helped you out?

say:47:1211135022:0.text: That's right! Without Magister Merlin's help, Merlindabest would've just stayed as a concept on paper.
say:47:1211135022:0.source_cn: 当然，没有梅林，小梅永远只能存在于设计图纸上。
say:47:1211135022:0.male: That's right! Without Magister Merlin's help, Merlindabest would've just stayed as a concept on paper.
say:47:1211135022:0.female: That's right! Without Magister Merlin's help, Merlindabest would've just stayed as a concept on paper.

say:48:1211135023:0.text: Merlindabest, Hardhead, Shorty, Fireside, Whistler, and Flintblaster will forever remember Merlin's grace!
say:48:1211135023:0.source_cn: 小梅，铁头，火墙，矮地，尖哨，还有小金箭将永远铭记梅林...
say:48:1211135023:0.male: Merlindabest, Hardhead, Shorty, Fireside, Whistler, and Flintblaster will forever remember Merlin's grace!
say:48:1211135023:0.female: Merlindabest, Hardhead, Shorty, Fireside, Whistler, and Flintblaster will forever remember Merlin's grace!

choice_prompt:49:1211135023.text: Merlindabest, Hardhead, Shorty, Fireside, Whistler, and Flintblaster will forever remember Merlin's grace!
choice_prompt:49:1211135023.source_cn: 小梅，铁头，矮墙，火地，尖哨，还有小金箭将永远铭记梅林对他们的恩泽！
choice_prompt:49:1211135023.male: Merlindabest, Hardhead, Shorty, Fireside, Whistler, and Flintblaster will forever remember Merlin's grace!
choice_prompt:49:1211135023.female: Merlindabest, Hardhead, Shorty, Fireside, Whistler, and Flintblaster will forever remember Merlin's grace!

say:50:1211135024:0.text: Go ahead and talk, I'm off to bond with Rosell. I'll get the cannons set up on the ship once we're good to go. Catch you later, friends!
say:50:1211135024:0.source_cn: 你们先聊，我去和罗赛尔加深一下感情，等准备妥当，就把大...

choice_prompt:52:1211135024.text: Go ahead and talk, I'm off to bond with Rosell. I'll get the cannons set up on the ship once we're good to go. Catch you later, friends!
choice_prompt:52:1211135024.source_cn: 你们闲聊，我去和罗赛尔加深一下感情，等准备妥当，就把大炮装到船上。再会，朋友们！

say:54:1211135025:1.text: Rosell... Did he just give my compass a name?
say:54:1211135025:1.source_cn: 罗赛尔……难道他给我的罗盘取了个名字？
say:54:1211135025:1.male: Rosell... Did he just give my compass a name?
say:54:1211135025:1.female: Rosell... Did he just give my compass a name?

say:55:1211135026:1.text: This guy is unbelievable... Forget it. Lucca's here, so let's ask him what he discovered.
say:55:1211135026:1.source_cn: 这家伙真是……哈哈……算了，卢卡来了，问问他有什么发现吧。
say:55:1211135026:1.male: This guy is unbelievable... Forget it. Lucca's here, so let's ask him what he discovered.
say:55:1211135026:1.female: This guy is unbelievable... Forget it. Lucca's here, so let's ask him what he discovered.

choice:49:0:1.text: I just did what I could.
choice:49:0:1.male: I just did what I could.
choice:49:0:1.female: I just did what I could.

choice:49:1:2.text: I was a major factor in your success.
choice:49:1:2.male: I was a major factor in your success.
choice:49:1:2.female: I was a major factor in your success.

say:0:1211136001:0.text: It's great to see you're all back safe and sound!
say:0:1211136001:0.male: It's great to see you're all back safe and sound!
say:0:1211136001:0.female: It's great to see you're all back safe and sound!

say:2:1211137002:1.text: Just as you expected, some fools tried to take advantage of the chaos and got blasted to bits.
say:2:1211137002:1.source_cn: 一切都好，和你预料的一样，有些不怕死的想浑水摸鱼，被大...
say:2:1211137002:1.male: Just as you expected, some fools tried to take advantage of the chaos and got blasted to bits.
say:2:1211137002:1.female: Just as you expected, some fools tried to take advantage of the chaos and got blasted to bits.

say:3:1211137003:1.text: Any luck finding the Dead Tide Fleet's base onshore?
say:3:1211137003:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队在岸上的基地找到了吗？
say:3:1211137003:1.male: Any luck finding the Dead Tide Fleet's base onshore?
say:3:1211137003:1.female: Any luck finding the Dead Tide Fleet's base onshore?

say:4:1211137004:1.text: I interrogated a Wight and found out there's a place south of Ashen Bay called Ragebone Cove.
say:4:1211137004:1.source_cn: 我抓了水鬼审问，说是在灰烬湾再往南的岛屿上。那地方叫兽骨滩。
say:4:1211137004:1.male: I interrogated a Wight and found out there's a place south of Ashen Bay called Ragebone Cove.
say:4:1211137004:1.female: I interrogated a Wight and found out there's a place south of Ashen Bay called Ragebone Cove.

say:6:1211137006:1.text: That Wight isn't one of their top guys, so I can't say for sure.
say:6:1211137006:1.source_cn: 那水鬼不是核心骨干，我不敢打包票。
say:6:1211137006:1.male: That Wight isn't one of their top guys, so I can't say for sure.
say:6:1211137006:1.female: That Wight isn't one of their top guys, so I can't say for sure.

say:7:1211137007:1.text: Rumor has it that Ashen Bay is a haunted, out-of-the-way place. It might be a good place for them to lay low.
say:7:1211137007:1.source_cn: 但我知道灰烬湾有闹鬼的传闻，人迹罕至，适合藏身，值得去看看。
say:7:1211137007:1.male: Rumor has it that Ashen Bay is a haunted, out-of-the-way place. It might be a good place for them to lay low.
say:7:1211137007:1.female: Rumor has it that Ashen Bay is a haunted, out-of-the-way place. It might be a good place for them to lay low.

say:8:1211137008:1.text: Do we know where Hodgkin is? Is he at the base near the shore or on the Immortal?
say:8:1211137008:1.source_cn: 霍德希金呢？他会在岸上的基地？还是不死号上？
say:8:1211137008:1.male: Do we know where Hodgkin is? Is he at the base near the shore or on the Immortal?
say:8:1211137008:1.female: Do we know where Hodgkin is? Is he at the base near the shore or on the Immortal?

say:9:1211137009:1.text: I don't have any solid leads on that...
say:9:1211137009:1.male: I don't have any solid leads on that...
say:9:1211137009:1.female: I don't have any solid leads on that...

say:12:1211137010:1.text: Boss, there's a Wight out here who wants to have a word with you about Hodgkin. Should we let him in?
say:12:1211137010:1.source_cn: 当家！有个水鬼帮的说要告密，和霍德希金有关。人给您带来...
say:12:1211137010:1.male: Boss, there's a Wight out here who wants to have a word with you about Hodgkin. Should we let him in?
say:12:1211137010:1.female: Boss, there's a Wight out here who wants to have a word with you about Hodgkin. Should we let him in?

say:20:1211137014:1.text: Hey, be nice to me, buddy! Don't just give all the credit to Al. I'm the one who brought you the information on Hodgkin!
say:20:1211137014:1.source_cn: 对我客气点，哥们！我可是给你们带了霍德希金的情报。有功...
say:20:1211137014:1.male: Hey, be nice to me, buddy! Don't just give all the credit to Al. I'm the one who brought you the information on Hodgkin!
say:20:1211137014:1.female: Hey, be nice to me, buddy! Don't just give all the credit to Al. I'm the one who brought you the information on Hodgkin!

choice_prompt:21:1211137014.text: Hey, be nice to me, buddy! Don't just give all the credit to Al. I'm the one who brought you the information on Hodgkin!
choice_prompt:21:1211137014.source_cn: 对我客气点，哥们！我可是给你们带了霍德希金的情报。有功，不能光让阿尔一个人立！
choice_prompt:21:1211137014.male: Hey, be nice to me, buddy! Don't just give all the credit to Al. I'm the one who brought you the information on Hodgkin!
choice_prompt:21:1211137014.female: Hey, be nice to me, buddy! Don't just give all the credit to Al. I'm the one who brought you the information on Hodgkin!

say:22:1211137015:1.text: I swear, I'm telling the truth!
say:22:1211137015:1.source_cn: 肯定的，我哪敢骗你们啊。

say:23:1211137018:1.text: So you're planning to take on Hodgkin, right? He's not at Ragebone Cove. He spends most of his time on the Immortal.
say:23:1211137018:1.source_cn: 你们要去打霍德希金对吧？他不在兽骨滩，平时都在不死号窝着呢。

say:24:1211137019:1.text: You'll only find Bonnie and Viperian if you go to Ragebone Cove.
say:24:1211137019:1.source_cn: 你们要是去兽骨滩，就只能碰上波妮和维珀里安。

say:25:1211137020:1.text: That's all I know. Whether you believe it or not is up to you.
say:25:1211137020:1.source_cn: 我知道的就这么多，别的我也不多说。信不信在你们。

say:30:1211137023:1.text: Do you think we can trust him?
say:30:1211137023:1.source_cn: 你们觉得这个水鬼的话可信吗？

choice_prompt:31:1211137023.text: Do you think we can trust him?
choice_prompt:31:1211137023.source_cn: 你们觉得这个水鬼的话可信吗？

say:33:1211137024:1.text: Hodgkin didn't care if they lived or died, and given their vengeful nature, I think we can trust what he said.
say:33:1211137024:1.source_cn: 刚才霍德希金一点没管他们死活，以这帮人睚眦必报的作风，...
say:33:1211137024:1.male: Hodgkin didn't care if they lived or died, and given their vengeful nature, I think we can trust what he said.
say:33:1211137024:1.female: Hodgkin didn't care if they lived or died, and given their vengeful nature, I think we can trust what he said.

say:34:1211137027:1.text: We'll prepare for both situations. Let's split into two teams and use the decoy strategy.
say:34:1211137027:1.source_cn: 那就做两手准备，我们兵分两路，声东击西。
say:34:1211137027:1.male: We'll prepare for both situations. Let's split into two teams and use the decoy strategy.
say:34:1211137027:1.female: We'll prepare for both situations. Let's split into two teams and use the decoy strategy.

say:35:1211137028:1.text: One team will act as a decoy to find the Immortal and draw away Hodgkin's fire.
say:35:1211137028:1.source_cn: 让一队人充当诱饵去海上找不死号，吸引霍德希金的主要火力。
say:35:1211137028:1.male: One team will act as a decoy to find the Immortal and draw away Hodgkin's fire.
say:35:1211137028:1.female: One team will act as a decoy to find the Immortal and draw away Hodgkin's fire.

say:36:1211137029:0.text: While the second team moves from Ashen Bay to Ragebone Cove to take out their base and then attack the Immortal from behind.
say:36:1211137029:0.source_cn: 另一队人从灰烬湾去兽骨滩，端掉死潮舰队在岸上的据点后，...
say:36:1211137029:0.male: While the second team moves from Ashen Bay to Ragebone Cove to take out their base and then attack the Immortal from behind.
say:36:1211137029:0.female: While the second team moves from Ashen Bay to Ragebone Cove to take out their base and then attack the Immortal from behind.

say:37:1211137030:1.text: Sounds like a plan! I'll be the decoy.
say:37:1211137030:1.source_cn: 好主意！我愿意当这个诱饵。
say:37:1211137030:1.male: Sounds like a plan! I'll be the decoy.
say:37:1211137030:1.female: Sounds like a plan! I'll be the decoy.

say:38:1211137031:1.text: I was going to send Lucca for this job... Since you're not a member of the Carmine Whispers, you shouldn't have to risk your life.
say:38:1211137031:1.source_cn: ……我原本想让卢卡去，毕竟你不是血薇帮的人，没必要拿命冒险。
say:38:1211137031:1.male: I was going to send Lucca for this job... Since you're not a member of the Carmine Whispers, you shouldn't have to risk your life.
say:38:1211137031:1.female: I was going to send Lucca for this job... Since you're not a member of the Carmine Whispers, you shouldn't have to risk your life.

say:39:1211137032:1.text: I'm from Rustport too. When there's a crisis here, we're all in it together.
say:39:1211137032:1.source_cn: 我难道不是锈锚港的人吗？锈锚港有难，谁能独善其身？
say:39:1211137032:1.male: I'm from Rustport too. When there's a crisis here, we're all in it together.
say:39:1211137032:1.female: I'm from Rustport too. When there's a crisis here, we're all in it together.

say:40:1211137033:0.text: Besides, you won't find a better captain any time soon. My compass will lead me to Hodgkin.
say:40:1211137033:0.source_cn: 再说了，你们一时半会也找不到比我更好的船长。我有罗盘，...
say:40:1211137033:0.male: Besides, you won't find a better captain any time soon. My compass will lead me to Hodgkin.
say:40:1211137033:0.female: Besides, you won't find a better captain any time soon. My compass will lead me to Hodgkin.

say:41:1211137034:1.text: Fair enough. Well then, Captain Sinbad, you've got this.
say:41:1211137034:1.source_cn: 这倒是。好，辛巴达船长，就交给你了。
say:41:1211137034:1.male: Fair enough. Well then, Captain Sinbad, you've got this.
say:41:1211137034:1.female: Fair enough. Well then, Captain Sinbad, you've got this.

say:42:1211137035:0.text: Here's the plan, Sinbad will head out on the Chainkeeper to draw Hodgkin's fire, and Lucca will stay at Rustport for backup.
say:42:1211137035:0.source_cn: 由辛巴达开枷锁号在前方吸引火力，卢卡镇守锈锚港，视情况支援。
say:42:1211137035:0.male: Here's the plan, Sinbad will head out on the Chainkeeper to draw Hodgkin's fire, and Lucca will stay at Rustport for backup.
say:42:1211137035:0.female: Here's the plan, Sinbad will head out on the Chainkeeper to draw Hodgkin's fire, and Lucca will stay at Rustport for backup.

say:43:1211137036:1.text: Magister Merlin and I will travel to Ashen Bay, sneak into Ragebone Cove to take care of Bonnie and Viperian, and then join forces with Sinbad for the final attack on the Immortal.
say:43:1211137036:1.source_cn: 我和梅林去灰烬湾，潜入兽骨滩，解决了波妮和维珀里安，再...
say:43:1211137036:1.male: Magister Merlin and I will travel to Ashen Bay, sneak into Ragebone Cove to take care of Bonnie and Viperian, and then join forces with Sinbad for the final attack on the Immortal.
say:43:1211137036:1.female: Magister Merlin and I will travel to Ashen Bay, sneak into Ragebone Cove to take care of Bonnie and Viperian, and then join forces with Sinbad for the final attack on the Immortal.

say:44:1211137037:1.source_cn: 这就是我们的作战计划，大家都了解了吗？

choice_prompt:45:1211137037.source_cn: 这就是我们的作战计划，大家都了解了吗？

say:46:1211137038:1.text: Now's our chance! Hodgkin's lost the Water Wights' support, and we've got Magister Merlin and Sinbad on our side. Let's take him down!
say:46:1211137038:1.source_cn: 很好！霍德希金没了水鬼帮助力，而我们还有大魔法师梅林和...
say:46:1211137038:1.male: Now's our chance! Hodgkin's lost the Water Wights' support, and we've got Magister Merlin and Sinbad on our side. Let's take him down!
say:46:1211137038:1.female: Now's our chance! Hodgkin's lost the Water Wights' support, and we've got Magister Merlin and Sinbad on our side. Let's take him down!

say:47:1211137039:1.text: Let us pledge by the iron wall of Rustport to ensure our safe return!
say:47:1211137039:1.source_cn: 对着锈锚港的风韧墙起誓，大家都要活着回来！

say:48:1211137040:1.text: Don't worry. No matter what happens, the compass will guide me safely back home.
say:48:1211137040:1.source_cn: 放心吧，无论发生什么，我都会让罗盘带我回家的。

say:50:1211137041:1.text: Alright, heroes of Rustport, let's set sail!
say:50:1211137041:1.source_cn: 那么，启程吧。锈锚港的英雄们！

say:53:1211137025:0.text: Even though Hodgkin didn't care about their lives, we still need to be cautious. After all, the Carmine Whispers and the Water Wights have been enemies for a long time.
say:53:1211137025:0.source_cn: 虽然刚才霍德希金一点没管他们死活，但还是要谨慎，毕竟血...
say:53:1211137025:0.male: Even though Hodgkin didn't care about their lives, we still need to be cautious. After all, the Carmine Whispers and the Water Wights have been enemies for a long time.
say:53:1211137025:0.female: Even though Hodgkin didn't care about their lives, we still need to be cautious. After all, the Carmine Whispers and the Water Wights have been enemies for a long time.

say:55:1211137026:1.text: That's right. We need to be well-prepared.
say:55:1211137026:1.source_cn: 没错，我们得有自己的战术。

choice:31:2:3.text: It's always good to have a Plan B.
choice:31:2:3.male: It's always good to have a Plan B.
choice:31:2:3.female: It's always good to have a Plan B.

say:56:1211137016:1.text: Well, I figured if Hodgkin doesn't treat us as equals, we have every right to make things harder for him.
say:56:1211137016:1.source_cn: 这才像样嘛……霍德希金不把我们当人，就别怨我们给他捅娄子。

say:57:1211137017:1.text: Let's see what kind of valuable intel you've got. Go on, we're listening.
say:57:1211137017:1.source_cn: 那就让我们听听你要提供多有价值的情报，说吧。
say:57:1211137017:1.male: Let's see what kind of valuable intel you've got. Go on, we're listening.
say:57:1211137017:1.female: Let's see what kind of valuable intel you've got. Go on, we're listening.

say:0:1211201001:0.text: Cross the bridge, head west, and you'll see the Ashen Bay. Stay alert.
say:0:1211201001:0.source_cn: 过桥往西就是灰烬湾，警惕起来。
say:0:1211201001:0.male: Cross the bridge, head west, and you'll see the Ashen Bay. Stay alert.
say:0:1211201001:0.female: Cross the bridge, head west, and you'll see the Ashen Bay. Stay alert.

say:1:1211201002:0.text: The Ashen Bay leads directly to the back of the Dead Tide Fleet. They'll have their defenses up.
say:1:1211201002:0.source_cn: 灰烬湾直通死潮舰队后方，他们一定有所防卫。
say:1:1211201002:0.male: The Ashen Bay leads directly to the back of the Dead Tide Fleet. They'll have their defenses up.
say:1:1211201002:0.female: The Ashen Bay leads directly to the back of the Dead Tide Fleet. They'll have their defenses up.

say:1:1211202001:0.text: Is that the wind? I seem to be hearing crows for some reason...
say:1:1211202001:0.source_cn: 是不是起风了？我好像听到乌鸦在叫……
say:1:1211202001:0.male: Is that the wind? I seem to be hearing crows for some reason...
say:1:1211202001:0.female: Is that the wind? I seem to be hearing crows for some reason...

say:2:1211202002:0.text: There don't seem to be any animals on the road anymore.
say:2:1211202002:0.source_cn: 好像路上都看不到小动物了呢。
say:2:1211202002:0.male: There don't seem to be any animals on the road anymore.
say:2:1211202002:0.female: There don't seem to be any animals on the road anymore.

say:0:1211203001:0.text: It's the fog again. That thick fog...
say:0:1211203001:0.male: It's the fog again. That thick fog...
say:0:1211203001:0.female: It's the fog again. That thick fog...

say:1:1211203002:0.text: There's... what's the word...? Con... condensation! Yes, there's condensation all over Chippy's armor!
say:1:1211203002:0.source_cn: 满满的盔甲上都凝出水珠了！
say:1:1211203002:0.male: There's... what's the word...? Con... condensation! Yes, there's condensation all over Chippy's armor!
say:1:1211203002:0.female: There's... what's the word...? Con... condensation! Yes, there's condensation all over Chippy's armor!

say:2:1211203003:0.text: Those Graveborn seadevils love this type kind of weather.
say:2:1211203003:0.source_cn: 那群不死的怪物最喜欢这种天气。

say:3:1211203004:0.text: I hope the mold devours their bodies, leaving nothing but bones behind!
say:3:1211203004:0.source_cn: 希望霉菌吞没它们，连骨头都不要留下！
say:3:1211203004:0.male: I hope the mold devours their bodies, leaving nothing but bones behind!
say:3:1211203004:0.female: I hope the mold devours their bodies, leaving nothing but bones behind!

say:1:1211204001:0.text: I hear crying sounds in the wind...
say:1:1211204001:0.male: I hear crying sounds in the wind...
say:1:1211204001:0.female: I hear crying sounds in the wind...

say:2:1211204002:0.text: Hey, isn't that the sound of just regular wind?

say:2:1211205001:1.text: The village looks like it's been pillaged.
say:2:1211205001:1.source_cn: 这村子看起来……被入侵了。
say:2:1211205001:1.male: The village looks like it's been pillaged.
say:2:1211205001:1.female: The village looks like it's been pillaged.

say:3:1211205002:1.text: By the look of the door, someone broke in...violently. This whole place has been ransacked.
say:3:1211205002:1.source_cn: 看房门，有人从门外暴力破门而入。目光所及，几乎都是这样。
say:3:1211205002:1.male: By the look of the door, someone broke in...violently. This whole place has been ransacked.
say:3:1211205002:1.female: By the look of the door, someone broke in...violently. This whole place has been ransacked.

say:4:1211205003:1.text: What happened here?! Were all the villagers captured by the Water Wights and the Dead Tide Fleet?
say:4:1211205003:1.source_cn: 这里发生了什么？！难道村民全都被水鬼帮或死潮舰队抓走了？

say:7:1211205004:1.text: But why would the Dead Tide Fleet take the villagers? They're already undead. Real people need to eat and sleep and can't work forever.
say:7:1211205004:1.source_cn: 但是死潮舰队抓村民有什么用呢？他们本身就是不知疲倦的亡灵……

say:8:1211205005:1.text: Well, there are never enough workers, and they also need more sea stingers. We always send their spies to work in Darkstone Cave.
say:8:1211205005:1.source_cn: 哼，劳力和薪柴永远不够用。我们也会打发水鬼帮的海蝎子去...

say:9:1211205006:1.text: The Dead Tide Fleet has failed to capture Rustport so many times. Maybe they need more men, or they just want to vent their anger somehow.
say:9:1211205006:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队对锈锚港久攻不下，来捉人补充或是单纯泄愤都不奇怪。

say:10:1211205007:1.text: But it's a whole village! So many houses, so many people...
say:10:1211205007:1.source_cn: 但是，这里是一整座村子啊！那么多民居，那么多人——

say:11:1211205008:1.text: Our casualties have also been high.
say:11:1211205008:1.source_cn: 我们弟兄的死伤人数只多不少。

say:12:1211205009:1.text: Our brothers and sisters would be lucky if their bodies found their way to the shore and were buried properly.
say:12:1211205009:1.source_cn: 如果尸首能被海波送回岸边，能有一块可以安眠的土地，都算...

say:13:1211205010:1.text: Those who became fish food or ended up at the bottom of the sea are too numerous to count.
say:13:1211205010:1.source_cn: 葬身海底和鱼腹的，更不计其数。

choice_prompt:14:1211205010.text: Those who became fish food or ended up at the bottom of the sea are too numerous to count.
choice_prompt:14:1211205010.source_cn: 葬身海底和鱼腹的，更不计其数。

say:15:1211205011:1.text: If the Dead Tide Fleet did this, then no.
say:15:1211205011:1.source_cn: 如果是死潮干的，就不可能。
say:15:1211205011:1.male: If the Dead Tide Fleet did this, then no.
say:15:1211205011:1.female: If the Dead Tide Fleet did this, then no.

say:17:1211205013:1.text: Let's split up and search separately.
say:17:1211205013:1.male: Let's split up and search separately.
say:17:1211205013:1.female: Let's split up and search separately.

say:18:1211205014:1.text: I don't want to waste any more time, but figuring out what happened here may give us clues on what the Dead Tide Fleet is planning and help us measure their current manpower.
say:18:1211205014:1.source_cn: 我不想多浪费时间，但搞清楚这里到底发生过什么，对于我们...
say:18:1211205014:1.male: I don't want to waste any more time, but figuring out what happened here may give us clues on what the Dead Tide Fleet is planning and help us measure their current manpower.
say:18:1211205014:1.female: I don't want to waste any more time, but figuring out what happened here may give us clues on what the Dead Tide Fleet is planning and help us measure their current manpower.

say:19:1211205015:1.text: I plan to slice open Hodgkin's chest, rip out his heart, and see if it's as black as his soul!
say:19:1211205015:1.source_cn: 我的目标就是刺中霍德希金的心脏，撕裂他的灵魂，瞧瞧他的...
say:19:1211205015:1.male: I plan to slice open Hodgkin's chest, rip out his heart, and see if it's as black as his soul!
say:19:1211205015:1.female: I plan to slice open Hodgkin's chest, rip out his heart, and see if it's as black as his soul!

say:21:1211205016:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't sit idly by and watch tragedy unfold here...
say:21:1211205016:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't sit idly by and watch tragedy unfold here...
say:21:1211205016:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can't sit idly by and watch tragedy unfold here...

say:22:1211205017:1.text: If there are any survivors... no, even if we can find some of their keepsakes, it'll comfort the souls of those who have lost their lives here.
say:22:1211205017:1.source_cn: 如果能有生还者……不，哪怕能收敛找到的遗物，也可以慰藉...
say:22:1211205017:1.male: If there are any survivors... no, even if we can find some of their keepsakes, it'll comfort the souls of those who have lost their lives here.
say:22:1211205017:1.female: If there are any survivors... no, even if we can find some of their keepsakes, it'll comfort the souls of those who have lost their lives here.

say:23:1211205018:1.text: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.
say:23:1211205018:1.source_cn: 那就是我们这些还活着的人的意义！
say:23:1211205018:1.male: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.
say:23:1211205018:1.female: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.

choice_prompt:24:1211205018.text: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.
choice_prompt:24:1211205018.source_cn: 那就是我们这些还活着的人的意义！
choice_prompt:24:1211205018.male: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.
choice_prompt:24:1211205018.female: For those of us that are alive... for those of us that have survived... we must do this for their sake.

say:25:1211205019:1.text: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's search the village.
say:25:1211205019:1.male: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's search the village.
say:25:1211205019:1.female: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's search the village.

choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 我也对村里情况很在意

choice:14:0:1.text: Will there be any survivors here?
choice:14:0:1.male: Will there be any survivors here?
choice:14:0:1.female: Will there be any survivors here?

choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 我们再在村里调查看看吧

say:27:1211205012:1.text: Sympathy and compassion... They're weapons used by the enemy to weaken your resolve.
say:27:1211205012:1.source_cn: 同情和怜悯……会成为被敌人拿来威胁的武器。
say:27:1211205012:1.male: Sympathy and compassion... They're weapons used by the enemy to weaken your resolve.
say:27:1211205012:1.female: Sympathy and compassion... They're weapons used by the enemy to weaken your resolve.

choice:14:2:3.text: Then you should show more sympathy.
choice:14:2:3.source_cn: 那么，你该展示更多同情
choice:14:2:3.male: Then you should show more sympathy.
choice:14:2:3.female: Then you should show more sympathy.

say:0:1211206001:0.text: The door's badly damaged and there's no one in the house.
say:0:1211206001:0.source_cn: 房门严重破损了，屋子里……没有人。

say:1:1211206002:0.source_cn: 幸好，也没有发现遇难者的遗体……

say:4:1211209002:0.text: What are you doing here, Sonja?

say:5:1211209003:1.text: Just searching. Have you checked out the well in the village?
say:5:1211209003:1.source_cn: 村里那口水井，你们探查过吗。
say:5:1211209003:1.male: Just searching. Have you checked out the well in the village?
say:5:1211209003:1.female: Just searching. Have you checked out the well in the village?

choice_prompt:6:1211209003.text: Just searching. Have you checked out the well in the village?
choice_prompt:6:1211209003.source_cn: 村里那口水井，你们探查过吗。
choice_prompt:6:1211209003.male: Just searching. Have you checked out the well in the village?
choice_prompt:6:1211209003.female: Just searching. Have you checked out the well in the village?

say:7:1211209004:0.text: <style="highlight">There are sounds coming from the well</style>, and it's not the sound of water.
say:7:1211209004:0.male: <style="highlight">There are sounds coming from the well</style>, and it's not the sound of water.
say:7:1211209004:0.female: <style="highlight">There are sounds coming from the well</style>, and it's not the sound of water.

say:8:1211209005:1.text: I don't know. Maybe it's crying or laughing...
say:8:1211209005:1.source_cn: 我不知道那是什么，可能是哭声，或者是笑声。
say:8:1211209005:1.male: I don't know. Maybe it's crying or laughing...
say:8:1211209005:1.female: I don't know. Maybe it's crying or laughing...

say:10:1211209006:1.text: We walked around the whole village, and we haven't seen a single person. It has to be the sound of the wind.
say:10:1211209006:1.source_cn: 一、一定是风吹过的声音吧！我们已经在村里转了大半圈，连...

say:11:1211209007:1.text: What if the well went dry...?
say:11:1211209007:1.source_cn: 如果我说，那是口枯井呢？

say:12:1211209008:1.text: The sewers of Rustport are filled with dirt and filth. I wonder how many people take the chance to hide smuggled goods or valuables underground.
say:12:1211209008:1.source_cn: 锈锚港的下水道藏污纳垢，不知道有多少人把东西藏在隐秘的...

say:13:1211209009:1.text: If they did the same thing here...

choice_prompt:14:1211209009.text: If they did the same thing here...

say:16:1211209010:1.text: Then let's go down the well and take a look. What if there really are survivors?
say:16:1211209010:1.source_cn: 那我们下井瞧瞧吧，万一真的有生还者呢！
say:16:1211209010:1.male: Then let's go down the well and take a look. What if there really are survivors?
say:16:1211209010:1.female: Then let's go down the well and take a look. What if there really are survivors?

choice:14:0:1.text: There might be someone in the well!
choice:14:0:1.male: There might be someone in the well!
choice:14:0:1.female: There might be someone in the well!

choice:14:1:2.text: Maybe someone hid in the well!
choice:14:1:2.male: Maybe someone hid in the well!
choice:14:1:2.female: Maybe someone hid in the well!

say:0:1211210001:0.text: I knew it. The sounds here are amplified.
say:0:1211210001:0.source_cn: 果然。洞里的声音被放大了。
say:0:1211210001:0.male: I knew it. The sounds here are amplified.
say:0:1211210001:0.female: I knew it. The sounds here are amplified.

say:1:1211210002:0.text: There seems to be a very pungent smell coming from... Achoo!
say:1:1211210002:0.source_cn: 好像飘来了很刺鼻的味道……阿、阿嚏！
say:1:1211210002:0.male: There seems to be a very pungent smell coming from... Achoo!
say:1:1211210002:0.female: There seems to be a very pungent smell coming from... Achoo!

say:2:1211211001:0.text: Ah... It must be fate. Fresh specimens delivered right to my door...
say:2:1211211001:0.source_cn: 瞧瞧，有实验品自己送上门了……

say:6:1211211003:1.text: What?! How did they end up here?! Weren't the villagers hiding here?
say:6:1211211003:1.source_cn: 他们怎么会在井底？！这里不是村民避难的地方吗？

say:8:1211211005:0.text: Come here, specimens. The chief researcher is waiting for our results...!
say:8:1211211005:0.source_cn: 来吧，新鲜的材料，首席研究员在等我们的研究成果……！

say:2:1211212001:1.text: There are guards here. This isn't a refuge for the villagers. This place belongs to the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:2:1211212001:1.source_cn: 有专人守门，这地方不是村民的避难所，而是死潮舰队的地盘。
say:2:1211212001:1.male: There are guards here. This isn't a refuge for the villagers. This place belongs to the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:2:1211212001:1.female: There are guards here. This isn't a refuge for the villagers. This place belongs to the Dead Tide Fleet.

say:4:1211212002:1.text: But this is right below Greenbrook! What have they done to the villagers?
say:4:1211212002:1.source_cn: 但这里是绿水村正下方！他们把村民怎么样了？

say:5:1211212003:1.text: ... If they specifically chose this place, then the Dead Tide Fleet must be secretly hiding something here.
say:5:1211212003:1.source_cn: ……专门挑这么隐蔽的地方，这里一定藏着死潮舰队的秘密。

say:6:1211212004:1.text: Yes... I've finally found their base of operations.
say:6:1211212004:1.source_cn: 很好……很好，终于被我摸到他们的据点了。

say:0:1211213001:0.source_cn: 咳咳——！这是什么刺鼻的味道？！

say:1:1211213002:0.text: Magister, there seems to be something in the dirt nearby...
say:1:1211213002:0.source_cn: 主人，旁边的污秽和白骨里，好像有什么东西……
say:1:1211213002:0.male: Magister, there seems to be something in the dirt nearby...
say:1:1211213002:0.female: Magister, there seems to be something in the dirt nearby...

say:2:1211214001:1.text: ... It's a piece of fabric. It looks like it was torn off from a shirt or something.
say:2:1211214001:1.source_cn: ……这是布料？看着像是从衣服上被扯下来的碎片。

say:4:1211214002:1.text: It's actually from a pair of linen pants. <style="highlight">Fishermen usually wear these when they're out at sea.</style>

say:6:1211214003:1.text: Fishermen...? But we found this among the mud and bones...
say:6:1211214003:1.source_cn: 渔民……？但这布料在淤泥和骨架中间……

say:7:1211214004:1.text: Could it be that all the villagers who disappeared are here...?
say:7:1211214004:1.source_cn: 难道、难道村里消失的人，都在这里——

say:10:1211214006:1.text: If the Dead Tide Fleet is defeated, these tragedies will never happen again.
say:10:1211214006:1.source_cn: 只要击溃死潮舰队，类似的惨剧就不会再重演。

say:11:1211214007:1.text: Let's go. They're waiting for us ahead.
say:11:1211214007:1.source_cn: 走，前面肯定还有人在等着我们。
say:11:1211214007:1.male: Let's go. They're waiting for us ahead.
say:11:1211214007:1.female: Let's go. They're waiting for us ahead.

say:0:1211216001:0.text: Be on guard. The Dead Tide Fleet is on high alert. They don't want their secret to be revealed.
say:0:1211216001:0.source_cn: 严加防守，死潮舰队很不想暴露他们的秘密。
say:0:1211216001:0.male: Be on guard. The Dead Tide Fleet is on high alert. They don't want their secret to be revealed.
say:0:1211216001:0.female: Be on guard. The Dead Tide Fleet is on high alert. They don't want their secret to be revealed.

say:0:1211217001:0.text: Wait, there seems to be a strange sound on the right...
say:0:1211217001:0.source_cn: 等等，右边好像有奇怪的声音……
say:0:1211217001:0.male: Wait, there seems to be a strange sound on the right...
say:0:1211217001:0.female: Wait, there seems to be a strange sound on the right...

say:0:1211220001:0.text: What are these things!? Are they a part of the Dead Tide Fleet?
say:0:1211220001:0.source_cn: 这些是什么！？死潮的人吗？！
say:0:1211220001:0.male: What are these things!? Are they a part of the Dead Tide Fleet?
say:0:1211220001:0.female: What are these things!? Are they a part of the Dead Tide Fleet?

say:4:1211221003:1.text: No, I don't think it understands us.

say:7:1211223004:1.text: She's just a lost soul, a <style="highlight">spirit</style>. She's not actually here...

say:10:1211223006:1.text: Why is there a spirit of a child here?! What did the Dead Tide Fleet...?
say:10:1211223006:1.source_cn: 这里为什么会有孩子的灵魂？！死潮舰队在这里干了什么？！

say:11:1211223007:0.text: Mother... is that you? I hear a voice...
say:11:1211223007:0.source_cn: 妈妈……是你吗？我好像听到了声音……

say:13:1211223009:1.text: Is there something you want to tell us?

say:14:1211223010:0.text: Hide and seek... Yes, let's play hide and seek.
say:14:1211223010:0.male: Hide and seek... Yes, let's play hide and seek.
say:14:1211223010:0.female: Hide and seek... Yes, let's play hide and seek.

say:15:1211223011:0.text: I won't make a sound. I won't let those bad ones know. <style="highlight">You must come</style>... find me...
say:15:1211223011:0.source_cn: 我一声也不出，我不会让那些坏人发现。<style=hi...
say:15:1211223011:0.male: I won't make a sound. I won't let those bad ones know. <style="highlight">You must come</style>... find me...
say:15:1211223011:0.female: I won't make a sound. I won't let those bad ones know. <style="highlight">You must come</style>... find me...

say:19:1211223013:0.text: Let's keep up. This won't be a simple game of hide and seek.
say:19:1211223013:0.source_cn: 跟上去，这不是一场简单的“捉迷藏”。
say:19:1211223013:0.male: Let's keep up. This won't be a simple game of hide and seek.
say:19:1211223013:0.female: Let's keep up. This won't be a simple game of hide and seek.

say:4:1211226002:0.text: It's the smell of decay... Disgusting...
say:4:1211226002:0.source_cn: 腐烂和发酵的味道……令人作呕的气味。

say:6:1211226003:1.text: Workstations, flasks, specialized equipment... I've seen rooms like this in the Serene Lyceum, but never one that gave off such an evil feeling...
say:6:1211226003:1.source_cn: 书桌、器材、培养器具。我在莱希拉姆见过类似的地方，但远...

say:9:1211226005:1.text: There are spirits out there, and the walking dead are among us...
say:9:1211226005:1.source_cn: 外面飘荡着灵魂，还有行尸走肉在徘徊！

say:10:1211226006:1.text: Check everything. There has to be some important information here.
say:10:1211226006:1.source_cn: 四处翻翻，我不信这里查不出情报！
say:10:1211226006:1.male: Check everything. There has to be some important information here.
say:10:1211226006:1.female: Check everything. There has to be some important information here.

choice:8:0:1.text: What are they working on here?
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队在这里研究什么？
choice:8:0:1.male: What are they working on here?
choice:8:0:1.female: What are they working on here?

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 我对邪恶的实验没兴趣

say:2:1211229001:1.text: This place... That document. What does it say? What is the Dead Tide Fleet planning?
say:2:1211229001:1.source_cn: 这地方……还有这张纸。上面写着什么？是死潮舰队的计划吗？

choice_prompt:3:1211229001.text: This place... That document. What does it say? What is the Dead Tide Fleet planning?
choice_prompt:3:1211229001.source_cn: 这地方……还有这张纸。上面写着什么？是死潮舰队的计划吗？

say:4:1211229002:0.text: Unfortunately, I'm not very familiar with these technical terms.

say:6:1211229003:0.text: According to what's written here, the researchers are trying to separate the soul of a creature and fuse it with other physical bodies.
say:6:1211229003:0.source_cn: 看上面的记录，这里的研究员在尝试将某种生物的灵魂单独剥...

say:7:1211229004:0.text: The Dead Tide Fleet has done this experiment many times with little success. However, a few have actually succeeded. The report says they need more specimens.
say:7:1211229004:0.source_cn: 死潮舰队试验了很多很多次，大部分都失败了，只有极少数有...

say:9:1211229006:0.text: Wait... do you mean the villagers?
say:9:1211229006:0.source_cn: 是那些村庄里消失的人吗。

choice_prompt:10:1211229006.text: Wait... do you mean the villagers?
choice_prompt:10:1211229006.source_cn: 是那些村庄里消失的人吗。

say:11:1211229007:1.text: The Carmine Whispers have sacrificed too much for me to turn away now.
say:11:1211229007:1.source_cn: 血薇帮伴随牺牲一路走到今天，我不会移开目光。

say:12:1211229008:1.text: Those blasted Graveborn... They clamor for eternity. I'll have their rotten bones buried forever at the bottom of the sea.
say:12:1211229008:1.source_cn: 该死的是那帮亡灵。他们叫嚣永恒，我就让他们腐朽的尸骨与...

choice:3:0:1.text: You read it. What do you think?
choice:3:0:1.male: You read it. What do you think?
choice:3:0:1.female: You read it. What do you think?

say:4:1211230003:0.text: I want to go home though... Let's go home...

say:2:1211232001:0.text: Take the boat... push through the waves...

say:9:1211232005:1.text: Look. There's a small dock with a boat.
say:9:1211232005:1.source_cn: 看前面，有船。这是个很简陋的船坞。

say:1:1211234001:0.text: Yes, we're out...! Where are we?
say:1:1211234001:0.male: Yes, we're out...! Where are we?
say:1:1211234001:0.female: Yes, we're out...! Where are we?

say:3:1211234002:0.text: The sea breeze is blowing from the east...

say:4:1211234003:1.text: This is the secret passageway from the Dead Tide Lab. It should be at the back of the Ashen Bay.
say:4:1211234003:1.source_cn: 这是死潮舰队研究室的秘密出口，那么，也就是灰烬湾尽头。

say:5:1211234004:1.text: Their headquarters must be up ahead.
say:5:1211234004:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队的大本营，一定就在前面。

say:6:1211234005:1.text: Let's go. While Sinbad is keeping them busy, we'll hit them from behind.
say:6:1211234005:1.source_cn: 出发。趁辛巴达驾船和他们周旋，我们从后方给他们一记痛击。
say:6:1211234005:1.male: Let's go. While Sinbad is keeping them busy, we'll hit them from behind.
say:6:1211234005:1.female: Let's go. While Sinbad is keeping them busy, we'll hit them from behind.

subtitle:2:1211090001:.text: We need to get out of here!

subtitle:2:1211090003:.text: Sinbad hurry! The ship's going... down!
subtitle:2:1211090003:.source_cn: 辛巴达快点，船马上就要沉了！

subtitle:2:1211090005:.text: Child, become the captain you were born to be, the compass will guide you.
subtitle:2:1211090005:.source_cn: 孩子，当你成为一个真正的船长，罗盘就会为你引路
